note: Machine mirror of Argosy's coupling axes for the git-commit hook and the release sweep; the axis names match AGENTS.md. Each rule carries its own checklist and proof obligations, so a report is actionable without further reading. Heuristics key on ADDED diff content in production sources only (src/test and src/androidTest are exempt), not file co-presence, to stay precise enough to block on.

rules.message: Plain Modifier.clickable() added in UI. Use clickableNoFocus and ensure an InputHandler covers it. Dual-modality (touch AND gamepad) is non-negotiable; a one-modality component is INCOMPLETE.
New PlatformDef added without a matching core/emulator registry change. Verify the platform/core lockstep set.

checklist: CONSUMPTION SITE -- where behavior actually changes (the ghost-setting trap)
SessionStateStore (if dual-screen/in-game) / RetroArch propagation (if it must reach the emulator)
rules.message: New preference key added. Trace the 15-link chain; the silent failure is a ghost setting that persists and displays but is never read.

SaveSyncEntity field added without a staged Room migration AND MigrationRegistry.ALL append AND DB version bump. A Migration_N_M object not listed in MigrationRegistry.ALL silently never runs; old DBs will get a null column or crash on open.

proof: negotiate returns no_op TWICE on a clean run
downloaded save appears at the path SaveSyncEntity.localSavePath claims
discoverSavePath and constructSavePath agree for the affected platform
rules.message: Save-sync change touched. This zone is fragile: the proofs below need live data and cannot be auto-verified, so they are raised here rather than enforced. Meet them before the change is shared, and say in the PR which were run and which were not. Maintainer review decides whether this is a real risk or a minor adjustment.

proof: diff a live API response against the model -- confirm no field silently nulled by drift
covers / multi-disc / user-props still populate after sync
version gating intact for device-aware variants
